title: The Bosch and Simó conjecture on the Shilnikov-Hopf bifurcation
summary: We provide a rigorous mathematical proof of the Bosch-Simó conjecture ( M. Bosch, C. Simó (1993), Physica D, 217--229) regarding the abundance of strange attractors in the unfolding of a Shilnikov-Hopf bifurcation. By constructing a general class of dissipative return maps that capture the essential global geometry of this codimension-two scenario, we demonstrate that "large" strange attractors -- in the sense of Broer-Simó-Tatjer -- are a persistent and statistically robust feature of the dynamics.
